method.appendix_extraction: Parsed the 36 track-item articles after #track-appendix in the preserved v2.0 HTML.

method.metadata_verification: GET Off-Road public API /_ah/api/offroadApi/v2/tracks/trackResult/{trackId}; no login token.
method.distance_rule: Use track.totalLengthKm when positive, otherwise track.layersStatistics.distance when positive.
